names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 18 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιο Νήπιο», with the rank words left off. The form recorded is the line's whole designation, because the page gives the child no name, no sex and no parents.

Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in the line for 18 ноября ст. ст., «Варул Антиохийский, отрок, мч.», with the rank word and «отрок» — which is his age and not his name — left off; the line declines it. This is the only one of the four calendars that gives this child a name at all. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's heading for 18. новембар ст. ст., „Св. муч. Роман и Варул.“, and confirmed in its body, «једно дете, по имену Варул» — «Св.» is “saint”, «муч.» is the `martyr` grade, and the name beside his is the other member of the pair, so the bare forename is the form. IT IS THE FIRST NAME THIS FOLDER HAS IN ANY SOUTH SLAVONIC OR GREEK SOURCE: the Greek line gives only «Άγιο Νήπιο», the Holy Infant, which is a description and is what the display name was built on. Measured: no other folder holds this string.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιο Νήπιο»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The head line gives «(; - 304)», the year the same day's Romanos carries, and the whole notice is three sentences: when Saint Romanos told the governor Asklepiades that even the children know the idols are not gods, the governor asked an infant which god it believed in; the holy infant answered miraculously, with clear articulation of voice, «τον Χριστόν»; and it was beheaded on the spot. A `death` is proposed from the head line, the page attaching the year to the entry itself. The page gives the child **no name**, so the display name is the designation the line prints and the slug carries the day; `sex` is `unknown` for the same reason — the Greek «Νήπιο» is neuter and the page never says boy or girl. `romanus-the-deacon-of-caesarea` is in `related`, is linked in the life, and is an upgrade on this same day. No `locations` and no hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 01.12.2025 (18. новембар ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Роман и Варул.“

attestations.note: The second name in the day's second entry. THIS BOOK NAMES HIM, where the Greek calendar that gave this folder its display name and its only other form prints only «Άγιο Νήπιο», the Holy Infant: the heading is „Св. муч. Роман и Варул.“ and the body says «виде св. Роман једно дете, по имену Варул», a child by the name of Barulas. The name agrees with the Russian calendar's «Варул Антиохийский», which is the identification this folder already rests on. THE DISPLAY NAME IS NOT CHANGED: a display name is the author's and this reader only records that a second calendar names him. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the book gives 303 for Romanus strangled in prison and dates the child's beheading only by putting it in the same hour, where this folder holds «303 or 304» from two calendars; the interval stands. No `related` row: Romanus is already there both ways and the governor is not a saint of this corpus. Measured: no other folder holds the form «Варул», so it folds with nothing.

death.note: Two sources one year apart and the interval is widened to hold both. saint.gr gave the 304 this folder held flat, which is the year it gives the deacon of the same day; days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 18 ноября ст. ст. with «(303)» and its life page closes the child’s death «(+ 303)». Neither page gives an age or a year of birth.
